TWIG Cruiser Ride

Durham, NC · Downtown · Social · Cruiser

Women / trans / femmeLGBTQ+No-dropBeginner friendly

TWIG Cruiser Ride is a social and cruiser group ride in Durham, NC. It rolls last Sunday of the month at 2:00 pm from CCB Plaza. About under 10 miles, 8–10 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 2:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 8–10 mph: you can talk the whole way. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @twigbikedurham the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the TWIG Cruiser Ride group ride

A monthly cruiser ride for the trans, women, intersex and gender-nonconforming community. Short, slow and no-drop. Any bike, casual clothes. Check Instagram for the time.
